_note: The bc19 map pools. Every board is PROCEDURALLY GENERATED from its seed by
the pinned 2019 engine (`coldbrew/game.js:76-361`) — bc19 ships no map
files upstream — so the NAME IS THE RECIPE: `seed-0043` is exactly what
engine under the pinned Node and writes `data/maps/bc19/<name>.json`,
including the post-`makeMap` MT19937 state; the results are COMMITTED and
`mixed` is the bc19 variant's played pool; `small` is what the parity
oracle and the docker smoke run on; `large` is reserved for a later
variant and supplies one of the nine parity pairs.
